title: Traffic Lights+
story: Every player drives their football through a busy town.
setup: 20x20 area, one ball each and four colored cone gates.
instructions: Green: travel; red: stop and freeze.
Amber: tiny touches; blue: change direction.
Let a player invent a signal.
Use gates as destinations, not queues.
coach_lens: Demonstrate in under 20 seconds and use one cue at a time.

challenge: Invite the other foot or a sole stop.

source.title: How to help 5-11s develop their skills on the ball
source.reviewer_notes: A common traffic-lights format written in original language and checked against federation ball-development guidance.
